reason: Fast Landing prerequisite for frozen Matrix landing PR #1059. Exact head d329dfda74db0a42f810185895a48b5a504080ff is frozen after WP-B M2 Independent Review run 33781548827 Ubuntu job 100736175569 failed only authenticated remote evidence. Re-reading the existing log and GitHub artifact metadata proves the first failing predicate is historical artifact retention state, not Matrix code: sealed artifact 8882246393 still has the expected name, digest and workflow head but is expired=true after its normal GitHub retention deadline; sibling Windows artifact 8882282133 is likewise expired while preserving exact identity/digest/head. Current verify-wp-b-m2-review.js incorrectly treats artifact.expired === false as a permanent integrity invariant. This authorization permits the minimum repair that separates immutable sealed artifact identity from time-varying download availability while preserving all run/job/head/digest/seal checks.

rootCause.directFailure: verify-wp-b-m2-review.js requires expected historical artifact id/name/digest/workflow-head AND artifact.expired === false; GitHub retention naturally changed expired to true on 2026-09-03 while all sealed immutable identity fields remained exact, causing WP_B_M2_REVIEW_REMOTE_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH.
rootCause.sameRootSurface: The M2 remote artifact comparison is the owner of this retention-vs-integrity conflation. No evidence found that M3 performs the same expired-artifact predicate, so M3 is excluded from this batch.
rootCause.requiredRepair: Keep exact artifact id/name/digest/workflow-head binding and all run/job/repository/seal checks. Treat expired as time-varying availability only: an expired artifact may satisfy historical sealed identity when the artifact record still exists and all immutable identity fields match. Missing artifact identity or any name/digest/head mismatch must remain fail-closed.
